Pull requests are not accepted in this repository. It is the translation of the Mac program and stays unchanged.

Open this against [tpw-port](https://github.com/ThemeParkWorldDecomp/tpw-port) instead (fixes, other systems, builds, tools; a changed game file is a whole-file copy under overrides/ with a row in FIXES.md), or against [tpw-mods](https://github.com/ThemeParkWorldDecomp/tpw-mods) for an optional change to how the game plays. The CONTRIBUTING.md of each says what it takes.

This pull request will be closed.
